itens.titulo: Notice About "ASOBIMO Account" Management and Request to Change Password
itens.texto:
Thank you very much for playing Toram Online.
An " ASOBIMO Account " that requires your email address (user ID) and password can be used to play Toram Online.
With "ASOBIMO Account", you will be able to log in to your game data on another device (same or different OS).
Be prepared for situations such as broken or lost device by submitting your "ASOBIMO Account".
★: The Right Way to Manage Your "ASOBIMO Account"
★: About Account Backup
★: Forgot Password for ASOBIMO Account
The Right Way to Manage Your "ASOBIMO Account"
Services that require a user ID and password may be at risk of List-Based Account Hacking (Credential Stuffing) , where login attempts are made by the hackers using the user IDs and passwords that may have leaked from other services.
To prevent unauthorized logins, your cooperation in the following aspects would be greatly appreciated.
1. Set a password that is different and not being used on other services .
2. Do not use a password that can be easily guessed .
If the conditions above (using the same password on other services and using easily guessed password) currently apply to you, please change your password immediately.
About Account Backup
Please submit your " ASOBIMO Account " beforehand if you have not done so in order to be prepared for unforeseen circumstances.
ASOBIMO Account Submission Procedure
1 Log in to Toram Online using the character which data you wish to transfer.
2 Tap [ Menu > Settings > Account Settings > Submit ] at the upper left of the screen.
3 Enter your " E-mail Address " and " Password ", then tap " Submit ".
4 A verification email will be sent to the email address you submitted.
Please also check out the " FAQ on our official site " for more details about ASOBIMO Account Submission.
Should you have any problem, feel free to contact us from [ Menu > Orb Shop > Contact Us ] at the upper left of the screen before continuing your action.
Forgot Password for ASOBIMO Account
You can re-issue your password by performing the following steps.
How to Re-issue Password
1 Log in to Toram Online.
2 Tap [ Menu > Settings > Account Settings ].
3 Tap [ Login > Change Submit Content > Re-issue Password ].
4 Input the submitted email address and tap [ Send ].
5 Open the link in the email sent to the email address you submitted using a browser.
6 Set the new password.
Notes
* You are responsible for managing and maintaining the confidentiality of your "ASOBIMO Account" name and password.
* Please note that your "ASOBIMO Account" and password are case-sensitive.
You won’t be able to log in if the capitalization is incorrect.
* Switching to another "ASOBIMO Account" may cause Orbs or Tickets that have not been reflected to appear on another account.
* We are not responsible for any issues that arise from owning multiple accounts.
